Jirav for Claude Install steps

Install the Jirav plugin for Claude

Add Jirav FP&A to the Claude desktop app in under a minute, then ask Claude about your plans, reports and numbers in plain English.

Step by step

You'll need the Claude desktop app, and this repository:

Jirav-Inc/jirav-claude-plugin
  1. 1

    Open Customize, then Plugins

    In the Claude desktop app, click Customize in the sidebar, then the Plugins tab.

  2. 2

    Add a marketplace

    Click + Add and choose Add marketplace.

  3. 3

    Add from a repository

    Choose Add from a repository.

  4. 4

    Paste the Jirav repository

    Paste Jirav-Inc/jirav-claude-plugin into the URL box, then click Use “Jirav-Inc/jirav-claude-plugin”.

  5. 5

    Sync

    Leave Sync automatically on, so you get each new version, and click Sync.

  6. 6

    Install Jirav FP&A

    Jirav FP&A appears under Plugins. Click Try in chat (or Add to install without opening a chat).

  7. 7

    It's installed

    Claude confirms “Jirav FP&A is installed and ready to use” and opens a chat with a first question typed for you. Send it.

  8. 8

    Take the tour

    Claude walks you through what the plugin can do. All it needs is a browser it can drive (Claude's built-in browser or Claude in Chrome) with you signed in to Jirav.

Using Claude Code?

Run these two commands:

/plugin marketplace add Jirav-Inc/jirav-claude-plugin
/plugin install jirav@jirav

Getting started

Open Claude's browser and sign in to Jirav yourself (Claude never enters passwords), then ask, for example: “What's forecast OpEx for Q3 in our Rolling Forecast?” or “Close last month.” More in the README.
